column1: # First-author last name and publication year for every PubMed ID (or, for the one
# signature that has no PubMed record, the DOI/URL) cited by the MethaDory Studies table
# and the EpigenCentral locus table. Used so those tables can link out with a readable
# "Lastname Year" label instead of the bare PMID.
# The year is PubMed's own citable pubdate year, which can differ by one from the
# StudyID/signature key used elsewhere in the track (those were assigned by the source
# labs, sometimes from an epub-ahead-of-print date); that is expected and not a typo.
# All PMIDs were looked up via PubMed esummary and the DOI via Crossref on 2026-09-21.
# On a data refresh, add an entry here for every new id before rebuilding the HTML
# tables; makeHtmlTables.py and epigenCentralToBed.py errAbort on an id with no entry.
